facilities.name: War Factory
facilities.blurb: The workhorse. Wheeled and tracked ground units, plus the support trucks the new Resupply rules need.
facilities.overlap: existing: recon, tank, heavy tank, artillery, flak

facilities.name: Hover Lab
facilities.blurb: Anti-gravity craft that float over land, shoals and sea alike. Fast and flexible, thinly armoured, and they overlap with the War Factory, the Shipyard and the Airfield.

facilities.name: Mech Factory
facilities.blurb: Legged walkers. Slow, tough and unfazed by terrain: they climb mountains that stop every wheel and tread.

facilities.name: Stealth Lab
facilities.blurb: Cloaked variants of ordinary roles. Invisible unless an enemy ends a move next to them, which makes scouting and sonar-style detection matter on land and in the air.

facilities.name: Training Ground
facilities.blurb: Specialist infantry: healers, engineers, heavy-weapon troopers and a cheap draftee. They fill the gaps between the soldier, the mech and the sniper, and make the front line sustainable.

facilities.name: Engineer Works
facilities.blurb: Builds immobile static defences that are placed next to your property and cannot move (move 0). Cheap to hold ground with, impossible to reposition.

facilities.name: Airfield (new aircraft)
facilities.blurb: New aircraft for the existing Airfield: a stealth interceptor, a ship-killing torpedo plane, an airborne radar, and cheap wartime-era fighters and bombers.
facilities.overlap: existing: transport copter, copter, fighter, bomber

facilities.name: Shipyard (new ships)
facilities.blurb: New hulls for the existing Shipyard: a floating airstrip, a nimble patrol boat and the heaviest gun platform afloat.

facilities.name: Glider Field
facilities.blurb: Cheap, silent, unpowered aircraft. No fuel, no engine, one way trips: they trade range and survivability for price.

facilities.name: Space Port
facilities.blurb: Orbital and re-entry hardware. Very expensive and very fast; the satellite is the only unit that can strike without ever being in reach.

facilities.name: Underwater Lab
facilities.blurb: Deep-sea hardware built on the coast: deeper divers than the submarine, sea mines, and expendable torpedo drones.

facilities.name: Drone Bay
facilities.blurb: Small unmanned aircraft. Individually weak, they win by numbers, sight and by keeping everyone else fighting.

units.name: Supply Truck
units.mechanic: Refills the ammo of every friendly unit next to it when it waits, at the usual price per round. Lets copters work far from an airfield. Unarmed.

units.name: Hover Scout
units.mechanic: The fastest ground-level unit. Crosses land, shoals and sea at the same cost, sees 2 tiles further than other ground units, but any hit hurts.

units.name: Hover Tank
units.mechanic: A light tank that skims water. Cannot be hit by sea mines and cannot capture. Loses its cover bonus on every tile, since it floats above it.

units.name: Hover Carrier
units.mechanic: Carries one foot unit across water and land. The passenger unloads from the bow ramp after the carrier moves, like a Deploy that does not use ammo.

units.name: Strider
units.mechanic: A bipedal walker with a cannon port on one arm. Treats mountains and forest like plain ground (move cost 1) but is weaker against tank rounds than a tread.

units.name: Titan
units.mechanic: Cannon ports on both arms and the most hit points in the game. Walks over woods and mountains and flattens forest it crosses into plain ground.

units.name: Rocket Walker
units.mechanic: A slim walker with a rocket pod mounted on its shoulder. Fires over a short ring (range 2-3) but not after moving, and climbs terrain like the other walkers. Lightly armoured.

units.name: Scout Walker
units.mechanic: A small, quick walker on thin legs. Sees one tile further than other ground units and crosses mountains and forest at plain cost. Carries one light gun port (range 1) and any real hit hurts.

units.name: Flame Walker
units.mechanic: A flamer port on one arm and a fuel tank on its back. Range 1 only, devastating against infantry and units in cover, weak against tanks. Its fuel tank makes it volatile: when destroyed it explodes, hurting adjacent units.

units.name: Bulwark
units.mechanic: A walker behind a shield plate. Takes much less damage from ranged attacks and strikes at range 1 with a piston fist. Slow, and the shield does nothing against bombs from above.

units.name: Troop Glider
units.mechanic: Carries one soldier. Costs very little, but after unloading it is consumed. No ammo and no fuel, and it can only land on open ground.

units.name: Scout Glider
units.mechanic: A hang glider with a pilot. Almost free, sees 4 tiles, unarmed. Falls out of the sky if anything at all hits it.

units.name: Drop Pod
units.mechanic: Launched, not driven: lands on any visible tile within 8 tiles of a friendly property, arrives with a Mech aboard, then the pod stays as a bunker (1 hit point more defence).

units.name: Shuttle
units.mechanic: Moves 12 and carries two foot units. Flies above fighters' reach: only flak can hit it, at half damage.

units.name: Orbital Satellite
units.mechanic: Placed on the board edge. Every third turn its laser can hit any tile in view of your units, for heavy damage. Cannot be attacked except by another satellite.

units.name: Abyss Sub
units.mechanic: Dives to a deeper layer than a submarine: sonar sees it only when adjacent. Slower, but its heavy torpedo outranges destroyers.

units.name: Mine Layer
units.mechanic: Drops a hidden mine on the tile it leaves. A ship that enters a mined tile takes 40% damage and the mine is spent. Mines are visible to units next to them.

units.name: Torpedo Drone
units.mechanic: Cheap and fast; one attack, then it is destroyed. Cannot be built unless you already own a Mine Layer or Abyss Sub.

units.name: Swarm Drones
units.mechanic: A pack of small drones: hits hard against infantry, little against armour. Weakens as its strength drops, since each drone lost is a quarter of the unit.

units.name: Repair Drone
units.mechanic: Repairs 2 hit points on every friendly unit next to it at the start of your turn, for 10% of the unit's price per point. Unarmed.

units.name: Gun Turret
units.mechanic: A light machine-gun pillbox with range 1-2 that fires at anything on the ground, best against infantry and weak against vehicles (low damage to tanks). It cannot move and has modest armour.

units.name: Cannon Turret
units.mechanic: A heavily armoured cannon with range 1-3 that hits ground vehicles hard and infantry only lightly. It has high armour, takes little damage from small arms, and cannot move or hit aircraft.

units.name: SAM Site
units.mechanic: Shoots only aircraft, with range 1-4 and heavy damage to fighters, bombers and copters. It cannot attack ground or naval units and is fragile against them.

units.name: Artillery Emplacement
units.mechanic: A fixed howitzer in a sandbagged pit that fires indirectly at range 3-6 with a minimum range of 2, so it cannot hit adjacent enemies. It cannot move at all, even by transport, and is vulnerable to anything that gets close.

units.name: Jammer
units.overlaps: Fog of war, Radar-style vision units
units.mechanic: Enemy units within 3 tiles of it can only see adjacent tiles, so fog of war closes in on everything inside the radius. Unarmed and fragile (about the toughness of a recon), so it needs an escort or it will be picked off.

units.name: Automated Factory
units.mechanic: Every other turn it spawns a free light robot (a weak walker that cannot capture) on a free adjacent tile, up to 3 alive at once. Immobile and unarmed; it has the toughness of a tank and can be destroyed, or captured by infantry like a normal building.

units.name: Land Mine
units.mechanic: One mine is placed per use. The first ground unit to enter the tile takes about 50% damage and the mine is spent. Invisible to the enemy unless one of their units is adjacent; engineers and mechanics can clear it safely.

units.name: Sea Mine
units.mechanic: A ship that enters the tile takes about 40% damage and the mine is spent. Hidden unless an enemy unit is adjacent; mine-clearing units can remove it safely.

units.name: Aircraft Carrier
units.mechanic: Carries 2 aircraft: planes can land on it, and each carried plane is refuelled and rearmed at the start of your turn. Only weak guns (a little damage, short range), so it needs an escort.

units.name: Dreadnought
units.mechanic: Four heavy guns with range 2-5 and far more punch than the battleship; it cannot fire after moving. Very thick armour, but slow and costly, and vulnerable to submarines and bombers.

units.name: Amphibious Tank
units.role: Land-and-sea assault vehicle: brings tank firepower ashore from the water.
units.mechanic: Moves over sea and shoals as well as land: move cost 2 on sea and shoals, 1 everywhere else. Armoured more lightly than a tank (takes noticeably more damage), cannot capture, and fires its gun at 1 range like a tank.

units.name: SAM Launcher
units.role: Tracked anti-air battery that threatens every aircraft in a wide ring.
units.mechanic: Anti-air only: range 1-4, hits both low and high air, and cannot attack ground or sea units. It can fire after moving but then has only 1 missile; it must sit out a turn to reload to its full 3 missiles. Fragile against ground attack.

units.name: Rocket Buggy
units.role: Very fast open-frame raider that strikes light vehicles and infantry.
units.mechanic: Direct-fire unguided rockets, range 1-2, strong against infantry and light vehicles, weak against tanks. Very fragile: any real hit cripples it, and it cannot capture.

units.name: Landing Craft
units.mechanic: A D-Day style landing boat. Carries one ground unit (infantry or a tank) in a single cargo slot, like the transport copter. After moving it can unload onto an adjacent land tile, and the empty boat is then just a hull. Unarmed and thin-skinned, so it needs an escort.

units.name: Missile Sub
units.mechanic: When surfaced it can fire long-range missiles (range 3-6, indirect, artillery-like damage, ground units and ships) but cannot move and fire in the same turn. While submerged it is hidden and cannot fire, so it is only exposed on the turn it launches. Few missiles per sortie; weak against anything that reaches it.

units.name: Hunter Sub
units.mechanic: Fast attack sub with strong torpedoes against ships and submarines (range 1), and a sonar that reveals submerged enemy subs within 3 tiles. Weak against air units and cannot hit land.

units.name: APC
units.mechanic: Carries two infantry units across land at tank speed and drops them where it stops. Armoured against small arms, unarmed.

units.name: Wall
units.mechanic: A wall segment that links to any wall next to it, so a row of them draws as one continuous wall and a ring of them as a fort. Blocks ground units, has many hit points, cannot attack. Walls and cracked walls link to each other.

units.name: Cracked Wall
units.mechanic: A weakened wall: the same blocking and linking as a wall, but it has few hit points and is destroyed by one ordinary attack (or an engineer), opening a gap in the line. Cheap, so it makes a good gate or a trap.

units.name: Training Ground
units.mechanic: Builds specialist infantry: commando, RPG trooper, mechanic, medic, mortar team, conscript, spy, diver, motorcycle.

units.name: Hover Lab
units.mechanic: Builds the anti-gravity craft: hover scout, hover tank and hover carrier.

units.name: Mech Factory
units.mechanic: Builds the legged walkers: strider and titan.

units.name: Stealth Lab
units.mechanic: Builds the cloaked units: stealth tank and stealth copter.

units.name: Glider Field
units.mechanic: Builds the cheap unpowered aircraft: troop glider and scout glider.

units.name: Space Port
units.mechanic: Builds orbital hardware: drop pod, shuttle and the orbital satellite.

units.name: Drone Bay
units.mechanic: Builds the small unmanned aircraft: swarm drones and repair drones.

units.name: Engineer Works
units.mechanic: Builds the static defences: turrets, SAM sites, artillery, jammers, mines and walls.

units.name: Underwater Lab
units.mechanic: A coastal base standing in the shallows. Builds the abyss sub, mine layer and torpedo drones.

units.name: Radar Station
units.mechanic: A support base with a large vision radius: it sees units hidden by fog from many tiles away. Cannot build or attack.

units.name: Supply Depot
units.mechanic: A support base that resupplies and slowly repairs every friendly unit next to it, whatever its type. Cannot build or attack.

units.name: Bunker
units.mechanic: A fortified property: a unit inside takes much less damage. Holds one unit, cannot build.
